question: 배송 완료된 주문은 몇 건이야?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered'

question: 결제 수단별로 결제가 몇 건씩 있었어?
sql: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type

question: 리뷰 평균 점수가 몇 점이야?
sql: SELECT AVG(review_score) FROM order_reviews

question: 2017년에 들어온 주문은 몇 건이야?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017'

question: 판매자가 가장 많은 주(state) 상위 3개 알려줘
sql: SELECT seller_state, COUNT(*) AS n FROM sellers GROUP BY seller_state ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 3

question: 주문이 가장 많이 들어온 고객 주(state) 상위 5개는?
sql: SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5

question: 상품이 가장 많이 등록된 카테고리 상위 5개를 영어 이름으로 보여줘
sql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english, COUNT(*) AS n FROM products p JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5

question: 리뷰 1점을 받은 주문들은 주문 상태별로 몇 건씩이야?
sql: SELECT o.order_status, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM order_reviews r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE r.review_score = 1 GROUP BY o.order_status

question: 평균 배송비가 가장 비싼 판매자 주(state) 상위 3개는?
sql: SELECT s.seller_state, ROUND(AVG(i.freight_value), 2) AS avg_freight FROM order_items i JOIN sellers s ON i.seller_id = s.seller_id GROUP BY s.seller_state ORDER BY avg_freight DESC LIMIT 3

question: 지난달 결제 수단별 결제 금액 합계 알려줘
sql: SELECT p.payment_type, ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018-08' GROUP BY p.payment_type

question: 2018년 상반기 월별 배송 완료 주문의 매출은?
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, ROUND(SUM(i.price), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: 2018년 카테고리별 매출 상위 10개를 영어 카테고리명으로 보여줘
sql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english, ROUND(SUM(i.price), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018' GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10

question: 상파울루(SP) 고객들이 가장 많이 산 카테고리 상위 5개는? 영어 이름으로, 팔린 상품 개수 기준
sql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name WHERE c.customer_state = 'SP' GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5

question: 판매자 주(state)별 매출 상위 5개는?
sql: SELECT s.seller_state, ROUND(SUM(i.price), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN sellers s ON i.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY s.seller_state ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: 2018년에 상파울루(SP) 판매자가 리우데자네이루(RJ) 고객에게 판 상품은 몇 개야?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN sellers s ON i.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE s.seller_state = 'SP' AND c.customer_state = 'RJ' AND strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018'

question: 건강·뷰티 카테고리 상품의 2018년 매출은 얼마야?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.price), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name = 'beleza_saude' AND o.order_status = 'delivered' AND strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018'

question: 바우처로 결제된 배송 완료 주문들의 매출 합계는?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.price), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM order_payments WHERE payment_type = 'voucher')

question: 2018년에 주문한 고객은 몇 명이야?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018'

question: 2017년 매출은 얼마야?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.price), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017'

question: 2019년에 들어온 주문 목록 보여줘
sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2019'
